definition: Whole is a nonempty Mathlib set of Bool-time/Unit-token pairs, ordered by subset as global parthood. Slice membership at t is wholeMaterial; wholeExists is nonempty membership at t. Ordinary equality of Whole is global set extensionality, and common nonempty subset parthood is UniversalFusionBoundary.Overlap. A whole is a part of itself, so token coincidence cannot imply equality of all parts. Global extensionality concerns every represented time, not just the initial slice. No actual object is inferred to be a temporal whole.
